questions.stem: A right triangle has legs of length 5 and 12. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
questions.explanation: Using the Pythagorean theorem: c = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) = sqrt(5^2 + 12^2) = sqrt(25 + 144) = sqrt(169) = 13.
questions.reference: FE Reference Handbook, Mathematics: Trigonometry - Pythagorean Theorem

questions.stem: Solve the quadratic equation x^2 - 5x + 6 = 0. What are the roots?
questions.explanation: Factor the quadratic: (x - 2)(x - 3) = 0. Setting each factor to zero gives x = 2 and x = 3. Verification: 2^2 - 5(2) + 6 = 4 - 10 + 6 = 0 ✓
questions.reference: FE Reference Handbook, Mathematics: Algebra - Quadratic Formula
